mapper.sql: id, doc_id, kb_id, doc_version, chunk_index, content, page_num, embedding, section_title, token_count
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kb_doc_chunk (doc_id, kb_id, doc_version, chunk_index, content, embedding, page_num, section_title, token_count) VALUES
(#{item.docId}, #{item.kbId}, #{item.docVersion}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content}, #{item.embedding, typeHandler=com.rhs.rag.handler.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{item.pageNum}, #{item.sectionTitle}, #{item.tokenCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, kb_id, doc_version, chunk_index, content, embedding, page_num, section_title, token_count, created_at FROM kb_doc_chunk WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{embeddingStr} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT id, doc_id, kb_id, doc_version, chunk_index, content, embedding, page_num, section_title, token_count, created_at FROM kb_doc_chunk WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND to_tsvector('simple', content) @@ to_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery}) ORDER BY ts_rank( to_tsvector('simple', content), to_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery}) ) DESC LIMIT #{topK}
